description: Karnataka begins land acquisition for the ₹20,000-crore Greater Bengaluru Integrated Township near Bidadi, despite opposition from farmers and landowners. BENGALURU TOP NEWS
body_lead: Despite opposition from farmers and political parties, the Karnataka government has issued the final notification to acquire nearly 500 acres for the first phase of the proposed Greater Bengaluru Integrated Township, popularly known as India's First AI City. The Karnataka government has taken a major step towards implementing the proposed Greater Bengaluru Integrated Township (GBIT) near Bidadi by issuing the final notification for land acquisition in the project's first phase. The decision comes despite continued protests and objections from farmers, landowners and several political parties.
